answer: Keys that cash out along the same path are billed as one operator. Each epoch the protocol groups keys that share a payout thread — the recorded withdrawal path they co-sign — into one grove. That grove must post a velvet equal to n times (n-1) / 25 POA, burned before any member's reward is released. Keys whose thread has ever co-signed a combined withdrawal stay in the same grove. A farm of 500 keys on one thread forms one grove: 500 x 499 / 25 = 9,980 POA the attacker forfeits.
